name: Pitcairn Honey
desc: A jar of dark, floral honey from the island's own hives, said to be free of the varroa mite that troubles bees elsewhere. It travels on the supply ship wrapped in a good deal of tissue. Restores 240 HP.

name: Pitcairn Orange
desc: A sweet, thin-skinned orange from an Adamstown tree. Islanders traditionally sold fruit like this to passing ships, and some of them are still sold the same way. Restores 150 HP.

name: Pawpaw
desc: Papaya, called pawpaw on Pitcairn: orange, soft and just a little smug. It grows well on the island and is eaten at every meal that will have it. Restores 190 HP.

name: First-Day Cover
desc: An envelope with a fresh Pitcairn stamp and a postmark of the day, ready for the ship. Collectors elsewhere will pay more for this than you'd think.

name: Miro Carving
desc: A little shark carved from dark miro wood, smooth from a lot of handling. It is the sort of present an island gives when it has decided it likes you.
